The '''Battle of Zehava''' was a standalone battle that took place shortly after the [[Young–Elders War]] involving only the members of [[the Young]]. Under the leadership of [[Mawat]], the splinter group called the [[Scavenger Young]] decided to start another war. Another group loyal to [[Nield]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] tried to stop them and a firefight began. However, it stopped when Qui-Gon appeared with a message from [[Cerasi]] who asked them to stop all fighting. It was the last conflict on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]].
